cluster_reason: Failable, FailableHelper and FailableRunnable form a tight cohesive group: the helper and runnable are closely tied to the Failable abstraction and show direct internal dependencies. Moving them together isolates failable-related utilities into a dedicated subpackage, reducing the size and responsibilities of the root package while keeping package-private interactions mostly local to the moved cluster.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive failable-related cluster (Failable, FailableHelper, FailableRunnable) into a dedicated subpackage to reduce God Component size.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move the Failable abstraction to the failable subpackage alongside its closely related helpers.
Move the helper utilities that collaborate with Failable to keep package-private interactions local.
Move the runnable variant tied to the Failable abstraction so related types remain together.
